info.title: API.SH: pkg.go.dev
info.description: The pkg.go.dev API from API.SH: public pkg.go.dev data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A module's go.mod at a version (default latest), parsed: module path, Go version, toolchain, requirements (direct or indirect), replacements, exclusions, retractions with reasons, tools and godebug settings, plus the original file.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pkg-go-dev-go-mod

parameters.name: version

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Packages in other modules that import a package, alphabetical, with `total` importers. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pkg-go-dev-imported-by

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Import path (github.com/gin-gonic/gin), or a pkg.go.dev link.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Module version: a semantic version (v1.2.3), latest, master or main (default latest).

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Module path, when the import path exists in more than one module.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Keep only importers matching this regular expression, e.g. ^github.com/.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Importers per page, 1-1000 (default 100).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (send it with the same other params); null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Go package: name, synopsis, module and version, whether it is the latest, standard library and redistributable, the packages it imports, licenses with full text, and how many packages and modules import it. Add `doc=md` (or text, html) for the documentation, `examples=true` for its examples.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pkg-go-dev-package

get.description:
Module versions as they are published to the Go module mirror, oldest first from `since` (default: the last hour). Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next batch (it may repeat the last version of the previous batch); null when caught up.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pkg-go-dev-recent

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO date or time to start from, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z (default: one hour ago).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Versions per call, 1-2000 (default 100).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (send it with the same other params); null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Searches Go packages on pkg.go.dev, best match first, with module, version, synopsis and how many packages and modules import each. Add `symbol` to find a function or type by name. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` (with the same other params); null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pkg-go-dev-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Find this symbol (function, type, method) within matching packages.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Keep only results matching this expression, e.g. `importedByCounts.packages > 100`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 20).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (send it with the same other params); null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every tagged version of a module (all major versions), newest first, with commit time, latest version, and deprecation and retraction notes. `pseudo=true` adds pseudo-versions. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pkg-go-dev-versions

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Module path (github.com/gin-gonic/gin), optionally with @version, or a pkg.go.dev link.

parameters.name: pseudo
parameters.description: true to include pseudo-versions.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Keep only items matching this expression (pkg.go.dev filter syntax, e.g. `kind == "Type"` or `hasPrefix(version, "v2.")`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Versions per page, 1-100 (default 50).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (send it with the same other params); null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Known vulnerabilities (Go vulnerability database) affecting a module or package at a version: id, details, aliases, fixed version and link. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pkg-go-dev-vulnerabilities

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Module or package path, or a pkg.go.dev link.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version to check (default latest).

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Module path, when the import path exists in more than one module.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Keep only items matching this expression (pkg.go.dev filter syntax, e.g. `kind == "Type"` or `hasPrefix(version, "v2.")`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, 1-200 (default 50).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (send it with the same other params); null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
